ThreadPoolMinThreads.title: Thread Pool Minimum Threads
ThreadPoolMinThreads.description:
Minimum number of .NET thread pool worker/I-O completion threads to
keep warm. Raising this avoids the runtime's gradual "hill-climbing"
thread injection delay under bursts of concurrent, blocking, or
synchronous work. Set to 0 to leave the runtime's own default
untouched. Positive values are used directly. Negative values are
treated as a multiplier against the CPU count, offset by one, e.g.
-1 means CPU count x 2, -2 means CPU count x 3, up to -9 meaning
CPU count x 10.

AutoSearchShowCandidateCount.title: Auto Search Show Candidate Count
AutoSearchShowCandidateCount.description:
The maximum number of TMDB search candidates to evaluate per auto-search
attempt for shows. Each candidate that passes the animation filter is fetched
in full (title translations + episode count) and scored; the highest-scoring
result is used. Higher values improve accuracy at the cost of more TMDB
API calls. All calls are paced by `TmdbRateLimiter` (sliding-window,
~40 req/sec) with automatic 429 backoff, so increasing this value slows
searches but will not trigger rate-limit errors.
The year-free candidate pool cap is `2 × this value`. At the minimum
of 1, year-free searches collect at most 2 candidates total — sufficient for
most titles, but edge cases may benefit from a higher value.

AutoSearchMovieCandidateCount.title: Auto Search Movie Candidate Count
AutoSearchMovieCandidateCount.description:
The maximum number of TMDB search candidates to evaluate per auto-search
attempt for movies. Each candidate that passes the animation filter is fetched
in full (title translations + release dates) and scored; the highest-scoring
result is used. Higher values improve accuracy at the cost of more TMDB
API calls. All calls are paced by `TmdbRateLimiter` (sliding-window,
~40 req/sec) with automatic 429 backoff, so increasing this value slows
searches but will not trigger rate-limit errors.
The year-free candidate pool cap is `2 × this value`. At the minimum
of 1, year-free searches collect at most 2 candidates total — sufficient for
most titles, but edge cases may benefit from a higher value.

Comparison stops at the first signal where the two candidates differ.

SourceOrder.title: Source Order
SourceOrder.description: Ordered source preference: first entry is most preferred.

ResolutionOrder.title: Resolution Order
ResolutionOrder.description: Ordered resolution preference: first entry is most preferred.

VideoCodecOrder.title: Video Codec Order
VideoCodecOrder.description: Ordered video codec preference: first entry is most preferred.

AudioCodecOrder.title: Audio Codec Order
AudioCodecOrder.description: Ordered audio codec preference: first entry is most preferred.

AudioLanguageOrder.title: Audio Language Order
AudioLanguageOrder.description:
Ordered audio language preference: first entry is most preferred.
Candidates are compared against this list in order — the first preferred
language present in one candidate but not the other decides the winner.
Empty list means no language preference — audio language comparison is always a tie.

SubtitleLanguageOrder.title: Subtitle Language Order
SubtitleLanguageOrder.description:
Ordered subtitle language preference: first entry is most preferred.
Candidates are compared against this list in order — the first preferred
language present in one candidate but not the other decides the winner.
Empty list means no language preference — subtitle language comparison is always a tie.

SubGroupOrder.title: Sub Group Order
SubGroupOrder.description:

Empty list means no group preference — subgroup comparison is always a tie.

PreferHigherBitDepth.title: Prefer Higher Bit Depth
PreferHigherBitDepth.description: When true, 10-bit video is preferred over 8-bit; when false, the opposite.

AutoDeleteOnImport.title: Auto Delete On Import
AutoDeleteOnImport.description:
When true, the auto-management check runs at the end of every import.
When false, no redundancy check is triggered on import; the check can
still be invoked manually via the API.

AllowDeletion.title: Allow Deletion
AllowDeletion.description:
When true, redundant release candidates are automatically deleted.
When false, the check still runs but only logs what would be removed
(preview/display mode). Requires AutoDeleteOnImport to
be true for the deletion to trigger automatically on import.

PerFileDeletionForAiringSeries.title: Per File Deletion For Airing Series
PerFileDeletionForAiringSeries.description:
When true and a series is still airing, redundancy is evaluated per-file
rather than per-candidate. Individual files whose episode coverage is
already provided by a higher-ranked candidate are deleted, while the
remaining files in that candidate (covering episodes the primary has not
yet reached) are retained.
            
When false (or when the series has finished airing), the existing
whole-candidate rule applies: a secondary candidate is only deleted if
its entire episode coverage is already subsumed by the primary.

EpisodeTypeScope.title: Episode Type Scope
EpisodeTypeScope.description:
Controls how episode coverage is measured for mixed-type releases
(releases that contain both regular episodes and specials).

ReleaseSignalType.description: Signals available for sequential release comparison.

EpisodeTypeScope.description:
